vulnerability_behavior.preconditions_for_vulnerability: Unconstrained pixel offset calculations using the floor() function.

vul_knowledge.solution_behavior: To mitigate the vulnerability, it is necessary to constrain the pixel offsets to valid ranges by using the ConstrainPixelOffset() function. This ensures that the calculated offsets remain within the bounds of the image dimensions, preventing out-of-bounds memory access and integer overflow. Specifically, replace calls to floor(x) and floor(y) with floor(ConstrainPixelOffset(x)) and floor(ConstrainPixelOffset(y)), respectively, to ensure that the pixel offsets are always valid and safe to use.
